question.text: The minimum investment of an AIF employee into an AIF scheme (for employee waiver purposes) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Employees or directors of a Category III AIF, or of its Investment Manager, may invest in the scheme with a minimum of Rs. 25 lakh, as an exception to the ordinary Rs. 1 crore minimum that applies to other investors. The Trap: Rs. 5 lakh and Rs. 10 lakh are below the prescribed minimum; Rs. 1 crore is the general investor minimum, not the employee/director threshold. Note: The Code of Conduct separately addresses pre-clearance and reporting formats for transactions by employees of the Manager.
